newsitem.title: USA: New England Investment to buy Jurika.
newsitem.headline: New England Investment to buy Jurika.

text.p: New England Investment Co LP said on Tuesday it agreed to buy California -based invesetment management firm Jurika & Voyles Inc for about $95 million in cash and units.
Jurika had more than $5 billion in assets under management, New England said in a statement. The acquisition would increase New England's assets under management to $91 billion, it said.
New England said it could pay another $15 million to Jurika over the next three years, depending on the firm's performance.

Jurika & Voyles, founded in 1983, had a fundamental, research-driven investment approach based on value and growth, New England said. Its management team would retain its investment independence and would continue to operate out of its Oakland, California office, New England said.
"In addition to their fine investment record, Jurika & Voyles give us a strong presence in Northern California," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Peter Voss said.
"Their strong weighting in equities will help increase our exposure to the equity markets and enhance our strength through diversification strategy," he said.
New England said the acquisition was due to be completed by the first quarter of 1997.
